spans.s: (in comp.) Vṛddhi form of पिता.

(-त्ती f.), 
-पैत्तिक a. 
(-की f.) Bilious.
a. Relating to father and son.

a. 
(-ही f.) [पितामह-अण्] 
__1 Relating to a paternal grandfather. 
__2 Inherited or derived from a paternal grandfather. 
__3 Derived from, presided over by, or relating to, Brahmā; यच्च पैतामहं स्थानम् [[
]]; अयोध्या सृष्टलोकेव सद्यः पैतामही तनुः (बभौ) [[

.]] 
-हाः (pl.) Ancestors, forefathers. 
-हम् The lunar mansion Rohiṇī.

a. 
(-की f.) Relating to a paternal grandfather (also पैतामहक).
(in comp.) Vṛddhi form of पितृ.

a. 
(-की f.) [पितृत आगतं पितुरिदं वा ठञ्] 
__1 Relating to a father. 
__2 Coming or derived from a father, ancestral, paternal; पदमृद्धमजेन पैतृकं विनयेनास्य नवं च यौवनम् [[

.]] 
__3 Sacred to the Manes. 
-कम् A Śrāddha performed in honour of the Manes or deceased ancestors.

__1 The son of an unmarried woman (पितृमत्याः पुत्रः). 
__2 The son of an illustrious person (पितृमतः पुत्रः).

पैतृष्वसेयः,
पैतृष्वस्रीयः, पैतृष्वस्रेयः The son of a paternal aunt; पैतृष्वस्रेयप्रीत्यर्थम् [[

.]] 
-यी the daughter of a paternal aunt; पैतृष्वसेयीं भगिनीम् [[

a. 
(-ली f.) Made of brass, brazen.

a. 
(-त्री f.) [पितुरिदम् अण्] 
__1 Relating to a father or ancestors generally, paternal, ancestral. 
__2 Sacred to the Manes. 
-त्रम् 
__1 The part of the hand between the forefinger and the thumb. (Also पैत्र्य in this sense.) 
__2 A year, month, or day sacred to the Pitṛs. 
-Comp. 
-अहोरात्रः one month.
